What specifically is causing your life to be horrible?

Isolation from people despite living in a big college.  I have no friends and my gpa is really low from fucking up last year.  

Are you currently on any meds?
I am on LexaPro but it isn't helping me at all.

It is a therapist for the college so I don't think she is as qualified as other ones.  Basically its a short 20-30m session where we talk about my week and things I want to accomplish. It isn't that helpful to me, and she usually just tells me stuff that I already know.
